subject: Request: transient-period continuity letter to cover SOC 2 gap
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medicore.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legalops@medicore.com
Date: 2027-07-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Transient-period continuity letter request for SOC 2 Type II

Hi Aisha,

Medicore is preparing for a procurement review and we need a short continuity statement (often called a bridge or transient-period letter) to cover the period after Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report end date through today. Our contract team needs a signed PDF that confirms there have been no material control changes since the report period ended and a brief callout of where supporting evidence lives.

Details we need included:
- Report: SOC 2 Type II (period Jan 1, 2026 - Dec 31, 2026), auditor: TrustAudit LLP
- Coverage needed: confirmation that controls in scope for that report remain in effect as of 2027-07-13, or a short exception note if there are exceptions
- Evidence pointers: high-level list of artifacts (SOC 2 PDF, KMS attestation, network diagram), and whether any items require a follow-up RFI
- Requested turnaround: 10 business days from receipt (we can expedite if you need)

Attachments we will need with the letter (if available): SOC 2 report PDF, KMS attestation or statement of key custody, and a current network segmentation diagram. If you prefer to provide the letter via DocuSign, that works for us.

Can you confirm next steps and estimated delivery?

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Medicore Health
samir.patel@medicore.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

--

Aisha / Samir — I can take the lead on the controls confirmation. Quick notes from our side:

- We reviewed change logs for the period 2027-01-01 through 2027-07-12. There are no control changes that would materially alter the scope of the SOC 2 report. The one operational change was a minor maintenance window for a logging agent in April 2027; we will document that as a non-material operational activity and include it as a note in the bridging statement.

- Evidence availability: SOC2_Redwood_2026_TypeII.pdf (final signed report) is in our compliance repository; KMS_Attestation_Jun2027.pdf is a short letter from our key management partner confirming key custody; Network_Segmentation_Diagram_v2.png is current as of 2027-06-15. I will attach staged copies for Aisha to review and for Samir's team to reference.

- Items to call out in the bridge letter: the audit scope, the report end date, an explicit statement that controls remain implemented as of 2027-07-13, and a short disclosure about the April maintenance event (language available below).

Suggested draft language (for the letter):
"Redwood Inference confirms that the controls described in the SOC 2 Type II report (TrustAudit LLP, covering Jan 1, 2026 – Dec 31, 2026) remained in effect as of July 13, 2027, except for a scheduled logging-agent maintenance window on April 21, 2027 which did not affect control objectives and for which compensating controls were in place. Supporting artifacts include the SOC 2 report, KMS attestation, and network segmentation diagram."

- Legal review: because this will be a signed attestation used in procurement, I recommend we run the final draft by Legal. Aisha, do you want Legal Ops on this? Samir cc'd Legal Ops so they can advise if any additional statement is required.

ETA: I can put a draft to Aisha by EOD 2027-07-14 and a final signed PDF by 2027-07-20 assuming Legal review is standard. If Medicore needs faster turnaround we can prioritize.
